I will plant improved maize seed this season because the agro-dealer in Arusha told me it yields more if I add fertilizer, and my cousin used it successfully last year. I will spread one bag of urea and one bag of DAP on each hectare of my three-and-a-half hectares — that is what I can afford after selling last season's beans. My family will work about 150 days on this plot, but I will hire another 130 days of labor for planting and weeding because the land is too much for us alone. I do not spray chemicals or use irrigation; I wait for the masika rains and clear weeds with hoes.
